protocol.purpose: Controlled retraining on the same saved R2 train/validation labels, before fresh heldout outcomes; not a rerun or expansion of stage2
protocol.train_and_validation: reuse exact R2 dense train128 and validation64 states; no new training labels or hyperparameter changes
protocol.history_removal: encode a copied observable state with penalties/counters/work zero, best tour=current tour, best length=current length; retain current configuration and frozen GLS lambda; reference edge remains the same specified conventional action, all edges scored
protocol.scope: removes penalty memory, incumbent route and dynamic counters; does not remove the current tour or the fixed solver parameter lambda; not claimed as a completely state-independent geometry model
protocol.device: CPU, one thread per run, both arms retrained to avoid training-backend confounding; no GPU context
protocol.loss: unchanged unweighted MSE pp + 0.1 non-tied same-state logistic ranking
protocol.checkpoint_selection: minimum original R2 validation regret; earlier checkpoint wins ties, reference action wins score ties; never select an optimization seed
protocol.fresh_heldout_policy: generate fresh heldout branches only after all six checkpoints frozen; no method/prompt/reward/threshold changes from these outcomes
protocol.ensemble: equal three-seed mean in each arm; no favorable seed choice
protocol.transfer_references: frozen R2 dense Transformer and previously fixed stage2 three-seed Transformer, scored only after ablation checkpoints frozen
protocol.interpretation: Separate controlled feature study; does not replace or tune the teacher used by the already frozen GRPO/main protocols. New heldout is not final.
